text.p: * Lower Chamber of Deputies passed the bank privatisation bill previously adopted by the Senate. The law must be promulgated by the president.

* Romanian Foreign Minister Adrian Severin addressed the Institute for Strategic Studies in Rome to plead for his country's early entry to NATO and the European Union. Severin's visit precedes a visit to Romania by Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi.
* The current budget will deepen poverty, leaders of the nationalist Greater Romania Party said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
